reviews_5s: You’re not breaking down giant chunks with this, but for the right amount at a time, it works like a charm. Super smooth, consistent grind every time. The 2.2" makes it slightly more difficult to grip but for me this isn't a downside as I like the compact size. I only mentioned it in case you have difficulty gripping things like this. Again though, the right amount of properly dried herbs and it's a cinch. A heck of a lot easier than a glass jar! 😂 Great price too and looks like an oreo cookie! So good.Cute and grinds well, it’s my first grinder so I don’t know if this is normal, but they don’t stay together so just be aware of that.Very cute ! I don’t even smoke anymore but it enhances the excitement to roll up and it doesn’t look so obvious !Well, I know I could return this. I threw it away instead too small to be useful for anything.Works well and is very handy.Gets the jib done. Works perfect. Very cute style. All of my friends want to swipe it. Going to buy a few as Christmas gifts. Great price.For $5, this sure is a great lil grinder! Nothing fancy, no separate compartment to catch your ground herb or anything like that. But it's lightweight, cute, and does it's job!Absolutely love it. And, It looks just like an oreo cookie 🍪 and it works very well.Does exactly what it needs to and at this price point, worth the money. I also think it’s really cute, looks like an Oreo.Does its job for what’s it’s used for. Highly recommend especially at this price point
